country.title: Account country
country.description: Two-letter country code used to select the Eufy account region.

maxConcurrentMediaSessions.title: Concurrent camera media limit
maxConcurrentMediaSessions.description: How many cameras may stream live video or take a fresh still at the same time. Use 0 for unlimited, which is the default. A camera refused because the limit is reached is never interrupted once it has started, and a still that cannot be taken now is answered with the camera’s most recent picture instead. Set this if several cameras at once make live view stutter on this host.

warmUpEvents.title: Warm up camera connections
warmUpEvents.description: Events that open a camera’s connection as soon as it reports one, so the live view or snapshot straight afterwards starts immediately. Every camera is independent: an event opens only the camera that reported it, and only for the events chosen here. A camera on its own battery is kept awake for several minutes each time; wired cameras and those behind a HomeBase are unaffected. Choose these in the plugin interface, which offers whatever your devices actually report.

ffmpegPath.title: FFmpeg path
ffmpegPath.description: Leave unset to use the FFmpeg executable bundled with the plugin.
